//: ONE authority for every version pin in this repository.
Anything that needs a version reads it here: the Nix flake, `bun run
setup:doctor`, and the `version-mirrors` guard. Nothing re-states a version
in a second file except the mirrors listed below, and those are checked.
The mirrors that exist, and who owns them:
.bun-version                      oven-sh/setup-bun in CI, proto locally
.github/workflows/ci.yml BUN_VERSION   a LITERAL, not a read of .bun-version
flake.nix                         reads toolchain.json, writes none
.moon/toolchains.yml              names the package manager only
The CI literal is a known second source, not an oversight. GitHub Actions
cannot read a file into `env:` at the workflow level, so the value is
repeated there and the `version-mirrors` guard is what keeps the two in
agreement. That guard found the real drift: `.bun-version` said 1.4.0
while CI pinned 1.4.2, and `bun install --frozen-lockfile` then failed in CI
with an error about the lockfile that named nothing useful.
`bun run setup:doctor` and `bun run guard` both check these agree. Note that
`guard` sets `options.cache: false` in scripts/moon.yml: the mirrors live
outside the scripts project and Moon cannot hash them, so a cached guard
would report `ok` on real drift.
The version the browsers must match. Read from the workspace copy of
@playwright/test, and cross-checked against the lockfile, because the
browser download is keyed by the package version.
The binaries themselves are NOT installed from the network on NixOS:
Playwright's Linux Chromium needs glibc and libraries a generic
`.deb`-shaped download does not link against. `flake.nix` supplies one and
`bun run setup:doctor` proves it launches; the symptom it prevents is
`error while loading shared libraries: libgbm.so.1`, which Playwright
reports as `Target page, context or browser has been closed`.
